name: Exterior Vinyl Siding RP Adhesion Primer
intent: STIX-class adhesion primer ALWAYS required on vinyl. Single coat. Spray primary.
doctrine: Vinyl adhesion primer. STIX-class (Insl-X STIX, BM Fresh Start, SW Extreme Bond). Always required regardless of condition — PVC is non-porous and rejects standard primers. Single coat. Recoat within 1 week.
